items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He was the one that sent for us to come over there.

ctx.x: On the earlier session of the two, there's "Tiger Rag," "Basin Street Blues, "Squeeze Me," "When the Saints Go Marching In," "Tommy's Blues" and "Rockin' For Panassie," for Hugues Panassie. Was Hugues Panassie much...?
He was the one that sent for us to come over there.
He sent for you to come over. All right. Did he talk with a lot of the musicians?
